newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Wages link in Australia inflation - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Wages link in Australia inflation - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello told parliament on Tuesday that the nation's inflation outlook was sensitive to wage developments.
"In relation to the inflation outlook, it is of course sensitive to wage developments," Costello said.
"And in relation to wage developments, it will be incumbent on both employers and employees to make sure that wages developments are kept within the band recommended by the Reserve Bank."
The central bank has said annual wages growth would need to remain between four percent and five percent to meet its target for underlying inflation of between two percent and three percent.
Costello repeated the August 20 budget forecast for 2.75 percent underlying inflation in the fiscal year to June 30, 1997.
The underlying measure excludes items not driven mainly by demand such as energy products and mortgages.
